title: Which kind of bond?
caption: A metal with a non-metal transfers electrons: ionic bonding. Metal atoms alone share a sea of delocalised electrons: metallic bonding. Non-metals share pairs of electrons: covalent bonding.
alt: A tree: is there a metal and a non-metal? Yes, ionic. No: only metals? Yes, metallic; no, covalent.
description: Metal and non-metal, such as NaCl or MgO: ionic.
Only metals, such as Cu or Fe: metallic.
Only non-metals, such as H₂O or CO₂: covalent.

q1.q: Does it contain a metal and a non-metal?
